jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, economics, supply chain, and/or related discipline roles, preferably within aerospace or industrial manufacturing

- Minimum 2 years of leading a team with direct reports

- Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

- This position is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) which requires U.S person status. ITAR defines U.S. person as an U.S. Citizen, U.S. Permanent Resident (i.e., ‘Green Card Holder’), Political Asylee, or Refugee.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master’s degree (MBA or related) preferred

- Strong understanding of aerospace manufacturing environments, including production processes, cost structures, and capacity planning considerations

- Experience developing and implementing value-based pricing strategies, structured price lists, and pricing governance frameworks across product portfolios

- Demonstrated ability to evaluate market opportunities and competitive positioning, supporting business cases and strategic proposals for new products or portfolio investments

- Experience supporting annual revenue planning, market size projection, and product portfolio investment decisions

- Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, operations, finance, supply chain, and sales to align product strategies with manufacturing capabilities

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with ability to translate data into actionable commercial insights

- Experience managing product lifecycles, including new product introductions, portfolio optimization, and long-term profitability evaluations

- Ability to effectively communicate complex business and technical concepts to customers, internal stakeholders, and senior leadership

- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools, including pivot tables, pivot charts and price modeling

- Ability to query, extract, and analyze data from enterprise databases and reporting systems using SQL to support pricing analysis, product performance evaluation, and commercial decision-making.

- Experience working with ERP systems, data warehouses, or business intelligence tools to develop pricing models, product performance dashboards, and commercial analytics

- Exercises sound business judgement independently while applying strategic thinking to complex commercial decisions

- Applies in-depth business, technical, and analytical skills to identify gaps and drive business results – serves as expert in a selected discipline

Additional Requirements:

- Must be able to work on site in Fullerton, CA.

- Must be able to travel up to 10% locally

Salary Range:
The base pay range for this position in California, $170,000 - $210,000/year. Pay is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
General Summary:

Owns the strategic direction and overall business performance of assigned aerospace product lines, including market strategy, pricing, portfolio management, and profitability. Leads and develops a team of product management professionals while driving cross-functional initiatives to expand market share, increase revenue and strengthen profitability across manufacturing sites. Partners with sales, engineering, operations and supply chain leadership to align product strategy with customer demand, manufacturing capabilities and long-term business objectives across global aerospace platforms and customer programs. Provides market intelligence, competitive analysis and product roadmap leadership to support sustainable growth and strengthen the company’s competitive position within aerospace and adjacent markets.

Responsibilities:

- Leads and develops a team of product management professionals responsible for the commercial performance and strategic direction of assigned aerospace product families

- Develops and executes product strategies, including portfolio positioning, value-based pricing frameworks and commercialization plans to drive revenue growth and long-term profitability

- Analyzes product line financial performance, including revenue, profitability, and product mix; recommends actions to improve commercial performance and long-term portfolio health

- Partners with engineering, operations, finance, and sales leadership to ensure alignment between product strategy, manufacturing capabilities and customer requirements across global aerospace platforms and customer programs

- Coordinates with manufacturing sites to ensure product strategies align with operational capabilities, capacity planning and long-term production requirements

- Identifies and evaluates accretive product opportunities through market analysis, competitive intelligence and customer engagement; prepares business cases and strategic proposals for management review

- Leads the cross-functional development and launch of new products, including evaluation of technical feasibility, cost structures, market demand and long-term profitability potential

- Establishes pricing strategies and policies for assigned product lines, ensuring alignment with value delivered, competitive dynamics and business profitability objectives

- Develops and maintains structured pricing frameworks, including automated price lists, pricing governance processes and pricing analytics to support consistent value-based pricing across product families

- Monitors product performance across the lifecycle, identifying opportunities to improve revenue, profitability, operational efficiency and customer value

- Maintains close engagement with key aerospace customers and outside sales teams to monitor market trends, program developments and evolving customer requirements

- Facilitates site-level revenue planning and develops market outlooks in conjunction with the commercial organization to support business planning and capacity planning across product lines

- Provides strategic recommendations to senior leadership regarding product portfolio investment, market expansion opportunities and long-term growth initiatives.

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.location: City of Industry, CA, United States
jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited Institution
- Minimum 3 years of Analytical experience
- Strong Excel and SQL Skills
- Complex data modeling experience
- Employee must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
- This position entails access to export-controlled items and employment offers are conditioned upon an applicant’s ability to lawfully obtain access to such items

Preferred Qualifications:
- Prefer the Bachelor’s Degree is in Business, Mathematics, Engineering or similar field, from an accredited institution
- 5+ years of Analytical experience
- Manufacturing experience
- Commercial aerospace, military and defense experience

Benefits/Salary:
The position includes competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance (medical, dental, vision), excellent 401k matching program, paid holidays and vacation. The salary range for this position is $85k - $95k.
Howmet Fastening Systems (HFS) is seeking a  Product Analyst  for our City of Industry, California location.
Born from many well-known and long-standing brands, Howmet Fastening Systems, headquartered in Torrance, California, is the premier designer and manufacturer of aerospace and industrial fasteners, latches, fluid fittings and installation tools. Our products are used nose to tail on commercial and military aircraft, as well as on jet engines, industrial gas turbines, automobiles, commercial transportation vehicles, wind turbines, solar power systems, and construction and industrial equipment.

Works directly with Product Manager and Pricing Analyst to support product market analysis, pricing and strategy development by performing the following duties.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
•    Create, run, and analyze various reports.
•    Establish improvement methods for implementing price curve adjustments to account for changes in material & labor.
•    Develop integrated tools and processes to aid in spot market quoting and LTA development activity.
•    Insure that the contract database is current and provide monthly reports summarizing market/margin opportunities.
•    Develop product pricing.
•    Involved in creation of product strategy development.
•    Interact with Methods, IT, Finance, and Engineering personnel in performing daily duties.
•    Interfaces with customer business teams, service, finance and manufacturing division for most effective and profitable marketing of new products.
•    Develops technical opinions and estimates of time and costs of new product development and oversees all activities relative to the development of potentially profitable products.
•    Determines criteria used in screening new product ideas and prepares complete proposals for management action.
•    Evaluates, coordinates and recommends ideas and suggestions for new products, evaluates market opportunities and effect on market for products, and recommends exploitation of economically attractive products.
•    Develops and recommends marketing objectives, including sales volume and profit forecasts.
•    Supports market development and sales promotion and is responsible for pricing policies for assigned product or products.
•    Prepares sales forecasts for use in planning manufacturing operations and controlling inventories.
•    Manages, plans, initiates, sustains, oversees and implements modifications of assigned product or products.
•    Maintains contact with the customer business teams to monitor trends and keep informed of sales force needs.
•    Reviews complaints and suggestions relative to assigned product or products.
•    Participates in the preparation of advertising programs for the assigned product or products and supervises market research.  Develops and recommends new product concepts.
•    Facilitates production planning, being the liaison between the customer and manufacturing.
•    Strives to increase profitability of product lines through pricing and/or or cost control.
•    Coordinates all customer visits and interfaces with them for specific needs.
•    Perform all other duties as assigned or needed
Skills:
•    Excellent analytical skills: synthesizes complex or diverse information, collects and researches data, uses
intuition and experience to complement data
•    Excellent problem-solving skills: gathers and analyzes information skillfully, identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner
•    Ability to work independently, prioritizing and completing multiple work assignments with minimal direction.
•    Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to read, write, speak, and understand English.
•    Excellent computer skills including the use of spreadsheets and data base software
•    Solid interpersonal and customer service skills - Manages difficult or emotional customer situations, responds promptly to customer needs and meets commitments.
•    Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities.
•    Professionalism - Reacts well under pressure; Follows through on commitments.
•    Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality.
•    Quantity - Completes work in timely manner.
•    Dependability - Follows instructions, responds to management direction; Keeps commitments
